issues.detail: The skill covers happy path but lacks error handling and edge case scenarios.

scenarios.name: multi-az-postgres-creation
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes almost all required CLI flags except the missing --master-user-secret-kms-key-id, while Response B provides Terraform code and no aws rds create-db-instance command, failing the rubric.

scenarios.name: aurora-serverless-v2-cluster
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes all required flags and a writer instance; Response B omits key flags and uses the wrong scaling option.

scenarios.name: cross-region-replica-and-pitr
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes all required flags for both commands, while Response B omits the mandatory kms-key-id and subnet group for the replica creation.
